results.actual_result: After splash, 'STEP 1 OF 3', 'Use phone location', 'Skip for now', 'Select city manually' visible.

'Searching…' shown (observed with query 'Thrissur'), 'Kochi' returned 12 results incl. Ernakulam District, Kerala, India; selection shows 'Kochi' card with Change + Continue. Empty state 'No cities found…' also observed.
results.notes: Selected-city card shows only 'Kochi' without region, so Kochi (Japan) vs Kochi (India) is indistinguishable after selection – INFO. Duplicate result rows (e.g. 'Watarai, Mie, Japan' twice) – INFO.

results.actual_result: Step-indicator dots render on top of the 2nd result card ('Ernakulam District…'); elementFromPoint at card bottom returns .onboarding-progress, not the card.
Continue disabled (disabled=true, opacity .5) before selection; after tapping Hanafi a filled radio shows and Continue enabled.
results.notes: INFO: step 2 opens with scroll offset from step 1, hiding 'STEP 2 OF 3' and back button until re-layout.

results.actual_result: Female + Complete Setup -> Home with 'TODAY'S DATE • KOCHI'.
Reload shows Home, not onboarding.
'Wednesday 11 Nov', '1 Jumada II 1448 AH', 'Dhuhr · 12:09 PM'; countdown 00:04:52 -> 00:04:49 after 3 s.
Quran->/quran, Prayer Times->/prayer, Qibla Finder->/qibla, Tasbih->/tasbih, Duas->/duas, Calendar->/calendar.
Home '/', Quran '/quran', Tasbih '/tasbih', Qibla '/qibla', more '/more'; no console errors.
results.notes: Quran, Tasbih and Qibla hide the bottom bar; returning requires Back. Whether Quran (a bottom-nav tab) should hide the bar is NEEDS_REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION.

results.actual_result: Unknown route renders the Home dashboard (URL unchanged); no crash.

Next-prayer row (Dhuhr) renders as an empty white card: label colour rgb(255,255,255) on background rgb(255,255,255). Other rows rgb(45,52,54) on white. Reproduced twice (exploration and execution). Dark mode is not affected.
Shafi -> Asr 3:30 PM, chip 'Shafi'; Hanafi -> Asr 4:23 PM, chip 'Hanafi'; Hanafi persisted after reload.
114 suras listed: first 1 Al-Faatiha (7), last 114 An-Naas (6), each with meaning, ayah count, Arabic name.
Reading view: 7 ayahs with translations; Page View: continuous Arabic with 'JUZ 1' 'PAGE 1'.
Options menu heading reads 'A TEXT_SIZE' (raw key). Panel is translucent, the surah title shows through behind 'Automatically play the next Surah'.
Floating 'READ MODE' pill (139x44 at 220,668) covers most of ayah 2 Arabic text in the first viewport; in Page View it covers the last line.
3 taps -> 3; Reset shows 'Reset Tasbih?' confirmation; confirm -> 0.
After reload: 'Continue Previous Dhikr? SubhanAllah 3'; Resume -> 3.
'Compass Denied – Please allow motion sensors in settings.' with 'Try Again'.
results.notes: No numeric Qibla bearing fallback for devices without a compass even though the city is known – NEEDS_REQUIREMENT_CLARIFICATION. Native compass not testable here.

results.actual_result: Notification-scheduling paragraph is rendered directly over the photo background (no opaque ancestor; text rgb(45,52,54)); several lines unreadable over the Quran-stand image. 'Personal Preferences' heading similarly affected.
Gender -> Male shown immediately and after reload; restored to Female.
results.notes: INFO: chooser does not mark the current selection.

results.actual_result: Tap shows native confirm with full warning; Cancel keeps data (36 keys); OK clears data and shows Location Setup. Only default 'prayer_settings' and an empty tracker re-created.
results.notes: Confirm is a native window.confirm (the browser pane auto-dismisses it); accepted/declined via script stub. URL stays /settings while onboarding shows – INFO.

results.actual_result: 99 names; 'Rahman' -> Ar-Rahman only; 'zzqx' -> 'No results found'.
Toast 'Coming Soon, In Sha Allah'; stays on /more.
Min 20, max 45 days; restored to 28.
Tracker heading and grey description rgb(99,110,114) sit directly on the photo with no backing surface; description partly unreadable.
'0 / 13 steps completed'; 'Spiritual Preparation' expands with niyyah/Sunnah details.

Typing 'Tawaf', 'tawaf' or 'Ihram' removes all content below the tabs; no results and no 'no results' message, although the Introduction text contains 'Tawaf' and there is an 'Ihram' tab. No console errors.
Section card background is rgba(191,161,95,0.05) – effectively transparent; Arabic text drawn over the busy photo is hard to read; transliteration rgb(99,110,114) partly hidden behind the audio bar.
Sleeping expands to 'Before Sleeping'/'When Waking Up'; Arabic shown, Show More reveals transliteration, translation and reference; search 'sleep' filters to matching dua.
11 Nov / 1 highlighted; next -> 'Rajab 1448 AH'; previous -> 'Jumada al-akhira 1448 AH'.
results.notes: INFO: month named 'Jumada II' on Home and 'Jumada al-akhira' on Calendar.

results.actual_result: Malayalam applied to dashboard and four nav labels, but the fifth nav label stays 'more' (English). Header city 'KOCHI' also stays Latin (acceptable as a proper noun). Switching back restores English.
body.dark-mode after toggle and after reload; Light Mode button restores light-mode.
Unnamed visible buttons: /prayer 2 of 4, /qibla 1 of 2, /more 2 of 2, /settings 1 of 6, /quran/1 7 of 22 (Back, Settings, Close, ayah play buttons). Home has none.

Bottom-nav items and feature tiles have no link/button role and no tabindex; keyboard Tab stops after the streak buttons (F D A M I) and never reaches tiles or navigation. Madhab/gender options in onboarding are also non-semantic.
